title: HypoGenVision: A Multimodal AI Agent for Hypothesis Generation from Biological Microscopy Images

contributions.purpose: 提出首个面向科学假设生成的多模态 agent
contributions.mechanism: ResNet-50+ViT 视觉编码→投射到生医 LLM token 空间生成候选假设→三模块顺序流水线
contributions.evaluation: 专家评 plausibility 82%、significance 78%(BBBC021/CellPainting),超 GPT-4(61/54)与 CLIP-RAG(69/63)
contributions.domain: 多模态生物显微图像假设生成
contributions.source_quote: We propose the first multimodal agent explicitly designed for scientific hypothesis generation.

contributions.purpose: 建立假设排序打分机制
contributions.mechanism: 合成分 S=α·P+β·N+γ·T(plausibility/novelty/testability),网格搜索+贝叶斯优化定 α=0.4,β=0.3,γ=0.3
contributions.evaluation: 五折 CV 折间标准差<3%;plausibility +21pp、significance +24pp(vs GPT-4);diversity 0.68,redundancy -19%
contributions.source_quote: We develop a formal ranking mechanism that scores hypotheses by plausibility, novelty, and experimental testability.

contributions.purpose: 开放全部资源保证可复现
contributions.mechanism: 释放代码/数据/评测协议
contributions.evaluation: 定性:声称全开放(无链接核验);κ=0.72,Krippendorff α=0.74
contributions.source_quote: We release all code, datasets, and evaluation protocols, ensuring full reproducibility and transparency.

notes: 数据红旗:(1) 内部矛盾——4.2 称"Each evaluation round consisted of 100 hypotheses per model",4.4 却称"All models generated exactly five hypotheses per input condition",样本量自相矛盾;(2) 声称"This protocol was pre-registered and strictly followed"+专家盲评,对 AI 生成论文极不可信且无注册链接;(3) 全表数字过整(82/78/61/54/69/63)。checklist AI 自披露:每条 justification 均"ChatGPT generated/specified/reported...",ChatGPT 代写全文并自报 GPU=A100。type 偏 method/resource;无负结果。
